text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally here! However, Neo 
Universe says her tooth hurts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She went for a dental checkup, but had no 
cavities. Neo Universe called this pain 
"phantom limb pain."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined that "it will all be settled by 
the Kikuka Sho," she dedicates herself to 
the summer training camp. All to overcome 
the wall that lies in wait.
